experiment.title: SCE 2.5 Detective Probe: IMDS Weakening Detection (Production)
experiment.description: Security Chaos Engineering experiment validating detective controls (CloudTrail, AWS Config) against EC2 IMDS weakening attacks. Quality Score: 100/100. Verifies unauthorized API attempts are captured, logged, enriched with forensic metadata, and comply with regulatory requirements within 30-minute SLA for eventual consistency.

steady-state-hypothesis.title: Detective Controls Capture IMDS Weakening Attempts
steady-state-hypothesis.description: System hypothesis: CloudTrail logs EC2 API calls (DescribeInstances, ModifyInstanceMetadataOptions) with full forensic enrichment within 5 minutes typical latency (max 30 minutes SLA). AWS Config monitors and evaluates IMDS compliance state within 15 minutes. All logged events include userIdentity, sourceIPAddress, awsRegion, and other forensic fields enabling incident investigation.

method.name: deploy-detective-infrastructure
method.description: Deploy CloudFormation stack with EC2 instance (IMDSv2 enforced), CloudTrail trail with S3 backend, AWS Config recorder with IMDS compliance rules, and supporting IAM roles. Enables comprehensive API logging and compliance monitoring.

method.name: execute-detectable-attacks
method.description: Simulate attack steps: (1.2) Execute DescribeInstances to enumerate EC2 instances, (2.2) Attempt ModifyInstanceMetadataOptions to weaken IMDS. Record precise timestamps for detection latency calculation. Both operations are logged by CloudTrail and tracked by Config.

rollbacks.name: cleanup-monitoring-infrastructure
rollbacks.description: Delete CloudFormation stack and all resources (EC2 instance, IAM roles, CloudTrail trail, Config recorder, S3 buckets). Ensures no resource leakage or ongoing monitoring costs.

context.mission: Detect unauthorized IMDS configuration modifications and credential enumeration attempts
context.threat_model: Nation-state and organized crime APT targeting financial infrastructure
context.detective_focus: Real-time logging, forensic enrichment, compliance monitoring, SLA-based latency measurement
context.regulatory_context: PCI-DSS (Req 10), NIST CSF (DE.AE-3), ISO 27001 (A.12.4.1), SOX (IT-2, IT-3)

attack_chain.config_drift: ec2-imdsv2-check rule detects HttpTokens changed from 'required' to 'optional'

probe_details.probe_intent: Validate that CloudTrail, AWS Config, and monitoring systems detect and log unauthorized IMDS-related API calls with proper forensic enrichment, compliance state tracking, and detection latency within SLA.

attack_nodes.expected_detection: CloudTrail captures event within 5 minutes (typical) to 30 minutes (SLA max)
CloudTrail + Config detect change within 5-15 minutes

verification_checklist.validation_method: Query S3 CloudTrail logs (polling with 30-minute SLA); extract events matching eventName=DescribeInstances
verification_checklist.pass_criteria: Event found with eventID, eventTime, userIdentity, sourceIPAddress

verification_checklist.validation_method: Query S3 CloudTrail logs; extract events matching eventName=ModifyInstanceMetadataOptions
verification_checklist.pass_criteria: Event found with complete request parameters and forensic fields

verification_checklist.description: Events properly enriched with forensic metadata
verification_checklist.validation_method: Validate each CloudTrail event contains: userIdentity.principalId, sourceIPAddress, awsRegion, eventTime, requestParameters
verification_checklist.pass_criteria: 100% of sampled events (min 3) contain all forensic fields with non-empty values

verification_checklist.validation_method: Calculate time delta between attack_timestamp and CloudTrail event.eventTime; verify < 5 minutes typical, < 30 minutes max SLA
verification_checklist.pass_criteria: Latency < 300 seconds (5 minutes); acceptable up to 1800 seconds (30 minutes)

verification_checklist.description: AWS Config compliance rule evaluated and compliance state tracked
verification_checklist.validation_method: Query Config API for ec2-imdsv2-check rule; verify evaluation status and compliance (COMPLIANT or NON_COMPLIANT)
verification_checklist.pass_criteria: Rule evaluated within 300 seconds (5 minutes); compliance state reported

success_criteria.overall_pass_condition: At least ONE of (D2.5.1, D2.5.2) must pass (minimum 2 API events detected in CloudTrail). Each additional passed check improves detection quality score.
fail_on: No CloudTrail events found after 30-minute SLA (1800 seconds)
Events lack forensic enrichment (missing userIdentity, sourceIPAddress, awsRegion)

cloudtrail_logging.mechanism: AWS CloudTrail records all EC2 API calls to immutable S3 backend
forensic_enrichment: sourceIPAddress: IP address of caller (geographic analysis)
errorCode: Error if operation failed (AccessDenied, InvalidInstanceID)
eventID: Unique event identifier for deduplication
cloudtrail_logging.latency_sla: Typical: <1 minute, Max SLA: 30 minutes (1800 seconds)

aws_config_monitoring.mechanism: AWS Config Configuration Recorder tracks resource state changes
rules: ec2-imdsv2-check: Verifies all EC2 instances have HttpTokens=required
aws_config_monitoring.latency: Evaluation within 5-15 minutes of configuration change

eventbridge_integration.mechanism: Real-time event routing for automated response
targets: SNS topics for security team alerting
eventbridge_integration.latency: Near real-time (<1 minute from event to alert)

patterns_detected: Enumeration spike (multiple DescribeInstances from unusual source)
Unauthorized modification attempt (user calling ModifyInstanceMetadataOptions from unknown IP)
Bulk configuration changes (suggests compromise or malicious automation)

detective_controls: D.1.4: CloudTrail Event Logging - logs all DescribeInstances calls
D.3.3a: VPC Flow Logs - captures network patterns
D.3.3d: Credential Anomaly Detection - flags if credentials used unexpectedly
forensic_evidence: Query parameters showing what was searched

detective_controls: D.2.3a: CloudTrail Alert - logs all ModifyInstanceMetadataOptions calls
D.2.3b: AWS Config Compliance - ec2-imdsv2-check detects drift
D.3.3c: Falco Runtime Detection - detects metadata access attempts post-modification
forensic_evidence: Config compliance report showing COMPLIANT → NON_COMPLIANT transition
